lesson.name: Learn the Ruy Lopez Marshall Attack
lesson.description: Learn the key ideas and structures that you need to play effectively with either White or Black in the Marshall Attack.

{White has defended poorly and Black can force checkmate in four moves. How
should you do it?} 16... Bh2+ {[%wrong There's a better attacking move. Look
at your checks and try again.] [%hint Force the white king to the corner.]} (
16... cxd5 $5 {Black is doing well, but it's better to aim for mate instead of
capturing material. How should you do it?}) (16... Qh2+ $2 17. Kf1 {White's
king will escape to the center. Try to find a better move.}) 17. Kh1 {Nice
move! How can you mate in three?} Bg3+ {[%wrong There's a faster path to mate.
Look at your checks and try to find it.] [%hint Retreat your bishop and attack
f2.]} (17... Bf4+ $5 {Black is still winning, but it's better to target the f2
pawn. How should you do it?}) (17... Be5+ $5 {Black is still winning, but it's
better to target the f2 pawn. How should you do it?}) (17... Bd6+ $5 {Black is
still winning, but it's better to target the f2 pawn. How should you do it?}) (
17... Bc7+ $5 {Black is still winning, but it's better to target the f2 pawn.
How should you do it?}) (17... Bb8+ $5 {Black is still winning, but it's
better to target the f2 pawn. How should you do it?}) (17... Bg1+ $2 18. Kxg1 {
White is winning. Try again.}) 18. Kg1 {Well played! How can you mate in two
moves?} Qh2+ {[%wrong There's a faster path to mate. Try to find it.] [%hint
Force the white king to f1.]} (18... Bh2+ $5 {Black is still winning, but
there's no need to repeat moves. Try to find a mate in two.}) 19. Kf1 {Great
work! Where's the mate?} Qxf2# {[%wrong That's not mate. Try again.] [%hint
Look at your checks. Which one is mate?]  Nice attacking play!} *
